column9: One section is missing, out of order, or a placeholder, or the draft is under 1,500 or over 2,500 words.
column12: Two or more sections are missing or placeholders; the submission is an outline rather than a draft.

column6: Both assigned reviews are submitted by the peer review deadline, and each answers all four questions.
column9: Both reviews are submitted, but one leaves a question unanswered.
column12: One review is missing, or both leave several questions unanswered.

column6: Each review is specific to its draft: it points at the passage it critiques, names a missing option, a verification gap, or an understated stake, and ends with the single strongest improvement the author can make.
column9: Each review has at least one point specific to its draft; the rest would apply to any RFC.
column12: Generic praise or a restatement of the draft; nothing the author could act on.
